name: Healthcare

mofsl_2qfy27.headline: Operationally strong quarter; outlook remains encouraging
mofsl_2qfy27.read: Pharma coverage revenue was 4% above estimates and EBITDA and PAT 9% above, helped by operating efficiencies and currency; aggregate revenue rose 17% YoY, EBITDA 23% and PAT 15%. US sales fell 3% YoY in constant currency (an improvement on the prior two quarters) but rose ~4.7% in INR; India domestic formulations (ex-GNP/TRP) grew 14.6% YoY against IPM growth of 14.8%, with chronic ~17% and acute ~13%. Super-specialty hospitals (ASTERDM, APHS, FORH, MAXH, MEDANTA) grew revenue/EBITDA/PAT 32%/38%/30% on ~22% volume growth and low double-digit ARPOB growth. Guidance: ALPM FY27 revenue growth 20-25% (from mid-teens), EMCURE above 20%, IPCA 14-16%, PIRPHARMA 19-20%, MANKIND EBITDA margin 25.5-26.5%, SUNP high single digit, MAXHEALT 500-bed Gurgaon Sector 56 by end-FY27, APHS ~1,800 beds in two years. Earnings upgrades: LAURUS 28.4%/30.4% (FY27/FY28), DIVIS 20.8%/18.5%; downgrades BIOCON 21.9%/14.5%.

unit_economics: Global generics: EBITDA = base US sales (prior base x (1 - erosion) + launches) + one-off exclusivities + specialty - COGS - R&D - front-end cost. India branded: IPM growth x relative growth x gross margin less MR cost (MRs x productivity). CDMO/API: molecules x wallet x tonnes x Rs/kg. Hospitals: EBITDA = beds x occupancy x ARPOB x 365 - fixed cost per bed.

price_drivers.driver: US base sales ex-exclusivity and launch refill
price_drivers.why: Share prices follow base US$ after stripping gRevlimid-type one-offs; Q2 US sales were -3% CC, and lower G-Revlimid hit DRREDDY, CIPLA and SUNPHARMA.
IPM grew 14.8% in 2Q with chronic ~17%; companies outgrowing IPM on volume (not price) earn premium multiples.

price_drivers.driver: Core EBITDA margin after FX and one-offs
price_drivers.why: Aggregate EBITDA grew 23% against revenue 17%; much of the beat came from operating efficiency and INR, which can reverse.

price_drivers.driver: Hospital ARPOB and occupancy as beds are added
price_drivers.why: Super-specialty chains grew ~22% in volume with low double-digit ARPOB despite aggressive bed additions; new-bed ramp decides margin.

price_drivers.why: An OAI/warning letter stops approvals from a site for years; NLEM and trade-margin caps (oncology) cut India realisation.

kpis.name: US sales and base US sales ex-exclusivity
kpis.definition: US generics and specialty sales in US$, with named one-off exclusivities (lenalidomide, tolvaptan, mirabegron) and milestones removed.
kpis.formula: US sales - named exclusivity sales - licence/milestone income +/- shelf-stock adjustments
kpis.why_it_moves_price: Exclusivity income is valued as a declining NPV, not at the sector multiple; a base that shrinks faster than launches fill it de-rates the stock, as lower G-Revlimid did in 2Q.
kpis.history_source: get_investor_presentation metric filter 'US sales' / 'North America' for SUNPHARMA, DRREDDY, LUPIN, ZYDUSLIFE, CIPLA, AUROPHARMA; get_financials for geography revenue; transcripts for US$ and one-off commentary (DRREDDY gives US$ only on calls); broker results-update notes (IIFL, Nomura, Kotak) for product-level estimates.
kpis.estimate_source: No consensus field; get_consensus_estimates gives Bloomberg Sales/EBITDA/PAT/EPS only; US$ forecasts come from broker models in the report library and call guidance.
kpis.traps: INR depreciation lifts INR growth while CC falls (2Q: -3% CC, +4.7% INR); one-off sizes are broker estimates, never disclosed; restated US$ histories (Lupin, Sun).

kpis.name: India formulations growth versus IPM (volume, price, new products)
kpis.definition: Domestic formulation growth against Indian Pharmaceutical Market growth from one audit source, split into volume, price and new introductions.
kpis.formula: Company secondary growth - IPM growth (same source and period)
kpis.why_it_moves_price: Chronic-heavy franchises growing ahead of IPM (2Q IPM +14.8%, chronic ~17%) earn the highest multiples; outperformance from price or launches with volume below IPM is discounted.
kpis.history_source: get_investor_presentation metric filter 'IPM' / 'India formulations' / 'market share' (SUNPHARMA, MANKIND, TORRENTPHARM, ALKEM, IPCALAB, AJANTPHARM); AIOCD-AWACS and IQVIA monthly summaries cited in broker notes in the library; MOFSL results tables carry the DF growth series.
kpis.estimate_source: No consensus field; Bloomberg Sales only; company guidance (IPCA domestic 15-16%, TRP DF 12% FY27, MANKIND) from transcripts.
kpis.traps: AWACS prints 1-3pp below IQVIA; do not mix sources; GNP/TRP low base inflates the aggregate (22% vs 14.6% ex-GNP/TRP); primary vs secondary gap.

kpis.name: Core EBITDA margin (ex FX, one-offs, licence income)
kpis.definition: Operating margin after removing net FX gains booked inside EBITDA, milestone and licence income, and shelf-stock charges.
kpis.formula: (EBITDA - FX gain - licence/milestone income) / core revenue
kpis.why_it_moves_price: FX and exclusivity flatter margin: Sun FY26 was ~28% ex-FX versus 30% reported; investors capitalise the core number, so a beat made of INR and one-offs reverses.
kpis.history_source: get_financials (revenue, material cost, employee, other expenses, FX line); get_investor_presentation metric filter 'EBITDA margin'; MOFSL results tables; broker notes name the EBITDA basis (ex-FX, ex-OOI).
kpis.estimate_source: get_consensus_estimates Bloomberg EBITDA / Sales gives implied margin on the street basis; company guidance (MANKIND 25.5-26.5%, ZYDUSLIFE 24%+, EMCURE 75-100bp expansion, IPCA +100-125bp).
kpis.traps: Three EBITDA bases in broker tables; other income inside EBITDA at DRREDDY/Natco; recurring 'exceptionals' at Sun; R&D capitalisation.

kpis.name: ARPOB and payor/case mix
kpis.definition: Average revenue per occupied bed per day, with international and insurance mix, for hospital chains.
kpis.why_it_moves_price: Super-specialty chains compounded EBITDA 38% on ~22% volume and low double-digit ARPOB in 2Q; ARPOB is the price-and-mix lever that determines whether new beds add margin.
kpis.history_source: get_investor_presentation metric filter 'ARPOB' for MAXHEALT, APOLLOHOSP, FORTIS, MEDANTA, ASTERDM, NH, KIMS; get_financials for revenue; transcripts for like-for-like ARPOB.
kpis.estimate_source: No consensus field; Bloomberg Sales/EBITDA/PAT/EPS only; ARPOB forecasts and bed plans from broker models and guidance (MAXHEALT, APHS, AGARWALE targets).
kpis.traps: Network ARPOB mixes new and mature hospitals; international patient share; pharmacy and diagnostics revenue sit outside hospital ARPOB for Apollo.

kpis.name: Bed additions, occupancy and EBITDA per bed
kpis.definition: Operational beds, occupancy % and EBITDA per operational bed, separating mature from ramping hospitals.
kpis.formula: Occupied bed days / (operational beds x days); EBITDA / average operational beds
kpis.why_it_moves_price: Volume +22% came with aggressive capacity adds (APHS ~1,800 beds in two years; MAXHEALT 500-bed Gurgaon by FY27-end); new beds dilute margin for 2-4 quarters until occupancy reaches 60-65%.
kpis.history_source: get_investor_presentation metric filter 'occupancy', 'beds', 'ALOS' for the hospital chains; capex and project notes in transcripts.
kpis.estimate_source: No consensus field; Company bed-addition guidance in transcripts; broker models.
kpis.traps: Operational vs total beds; occupancy on a mature-hospital basis; Fortis and Aster restated perimeters after mergers (ASTERDM merger synergy INR2b).

kpis.name: CDMO and API revenue growth and customer offtake
kpis.definition: CRDMO/CDMO and API segment revenue growth, commercial-molecule share and top-customer concentration.
kpis.why_it_moves_price: Lower customer offtake in CRDMO caused BIOCON's 68.6% earnings miss; DIVISLAB beat by 33% on generics plus custom synthesis, so offtake timing drives large single-quarter moves.
kpis.history_source: get_investor_presentation metric filter 'CDMO' / 'custom synthesis' / 'CRDMO' (DIVISLAB, LAURUSLABS, SYNGENE, NEULANDLAB, SAILIFE); get_financials segment note; transcripts for destocking language.
kpis.estimate_source: No consensus field; Bloomberg Sales/EBITDA only; capex commercialisation guidance in transcripts (DIVI: one of three major projects near commercial) and broker notes.
kpis.traps: Single shipments move quarters 20-40%; molecule names never disclosed; inventory build inflates gross margin; development vs commercial reclassification.

kpis.name: USFDA site status and approvals pipeline
kpis.definition: Share of US revenue and pending ANDAs at plants under OAI, warning letter or import alert, with re-inspection dates.
kpis.formula: US revenue from flagged sites / total US revenue
kpis.why_it_moves_price: An OAI stops approvals from a site for 1-7+ years while existing supply continues; clearance (Sun Halol is the open case) re-rates the stock.
kpis.history_source: Transcripts and annual reports in the library (read_library_document); USFDA outcome notes in broker updates; search_research filter 'warning letter' / 'OAI'.
kpis.estimate_source: No consensus field; Management timelines in transcripts; broker risk notes.
kpis.traps: Remediation dates slip; partner/CMO sites omitted; OAI rate ~12% of India inspections.

kpis.name: Field force and productivity (MRs, PCPM)
kpis.definition: Medical representatives and Rx sales per MR per month in Rs lakh for India-branded companies.
kpis.formula: India branded Rx sales / average MRs / 12
kpis.unit: Rs lakh per MR per month
kpis.why_it_moves_price: New MRs take 12-18 months to become productive, so additions (TRP ~9,100 MRs, +~500 evaluated for FY28) depress margin first and lift growth later.
kpis.history_source: get_investor_presentation metric filter 'MR' / 'field force' / 'productivity'; annual reports for year-end MR counts; transcripts.
kpis.estimate_source: No consensus field; Company guidance in transcripts; broker models.
kpis.traps: Company sales per MR includes consumer and trade generics; year-end vs average MRs.

kpis.name: Diagnostics volume, realisation per test and margin
kpis.definition: Test volumes, revenue per patient or test and EBITDA margin for diagnostics chains.
kpis.why_it_moves_price: MOLBIO held FY27 guidance of ~25% revenue growth and 24-25% margin; diagnostics rerate on volume growth with stable realisation and collection-centre productivity.
kpis.history_source: get_investor_presentation metric filter 'patients' / 'tests' / 'revenue per patient' (DRLAL, METROPOLIS, THYROCARE, VIJAYA); get_financials.
kpis.estimate_source: No consensus field; Bloomberg Sales/EBITDA only; guidance in transcripts.
kpis.traps: Covid-era base for older series; B2B vs B2C mix; home collection cost.

valuation_anchor: Pharma: P/E on 1-2 year forward base EPS (ex one-off exclusivities, ex treasury) plus exclusivity NPV, against own post-FY25 band; SOTP for diversified groups (India branded 20-32x EBITDA, US generics 8-12x). Hospitals: EV/EBITDA on forward EBITDA and EV per operational bed. CDMO: EV/core EBITDA with P/E cross-check.
